title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Lemon Lime
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K + 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Lemon Lime Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This convenient replacement pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a bright and zesty citrus blend. Lemon Lime combines sharp Lemon with zesty Lime to create a crisp-tasting vape with bright, citrusy flavour from start to finish. Ideal for fans of fruit blends with a tart edge, this classic citrus duo delivers just the right amount of tang to bring a little sunshine to the even the greyest of days. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
